'''AB-6H Guardian Droid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]] to guard the asteroid level of [[The Coil (Obus VI)|The Coil]], his base on [[Obus VI]]. In [[3630 BBY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] detected and [[Escape from the Coil|engaged]] intruders, though it was destroyed by [[HK-55]] and [[Z0-0M]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
AB-6H Guardian Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' {{1st}}
